name: Buddy
description: Buddy is a friendly and energetic Golden Retriever who loves playing fetch and going on long walks. He's great with children and other dogs. House-trained and knows basic commands like sit, stay, and shake.

name: Luna
description: Luna is a gorgeous Persian cat with a calm and affectionate personality. She enjoys lounging in sunny spots and being brushed. Perfect for a quiet household looking for a loving companion.

name: Max
description: Max is a loyal and intelligent German Shepherd. He's well-trained and protective, making him an excellent family guardian. Enjoys training sessions and outdoor activities.

name: Mochi
description: Mochi is an adorable Scottish Fold kitten with folded ears and big round eyes. She's curious, playful, and loves chasing toy mice. Gets along well with other cats.

name: Kiwi
description: Kiwi is a charming Cockatiel who loves to whistle tunes and sit on your shoulder. Hand-raised and very comfortable around people. Can mimic simple melodies.

name: Cinnamon
description: Cinnamon is a sweet Holland Lop bunny with floppy ears and a soft cinnamon-colored coat. She loves being held and enjoys munching on fresh vegetables and hay.

name: Charlie
description: Charlie is a cheerful Beagle with an incredible nose and a heart of gold. He's great on leash walks and loves sniffing out new adventures. Very food-motivated which makes training easy.

name: Shadow
description: Shadow is a stunning British Shorthair with a plush blue-grey coat. He's independent yet affectionate on his own terms. Enjoys watching birds from windows and napping in cozy spots.
